div.head: V As 1.2
div.ab: And swylce gerefa swylce ðis forgymeleasige ⁊ ymb beo nylle, gesylle ðæm cyng his oferhyrnysse, gif him mon ongerecce mid soþe, ⁊ he hine ungereccan ne mæge.
⁊ swylc gerefa swylc ðis forgemeleasie ⁊ ymbe beon nylle, gesylle ðam cinge his oferhyrnesse, gif hit man him ongerecce mid soþe.
Et prepositus qui hoc peruertet et inde curare nolet, emendet regi suam ouerhernessam, si pernoscatur hoc in ueritate, et se non possit reicere.
⁊ swylc gerefa swylc ðis foregemeleasie ⁊ ymbe beon nylle, gesylle ðam cinge his oferhyrnesse, gif hit man him ongerecce mid soþe, [⁊ he hine ungereccan ne mæge].
And any reeve who neglects this, and pays no heed to it, shall pay [the fine] for insubordination to the king, if he is justly accused and cannot clear himself.
And such reeve as neglects this and will not be zealous about it is to pay to the king the fine for disobedience to him, if he is truly accused of it.

Und jeder Vogt, welcher dies vernachlässigt und dafür nicht sorgen will, zahle dem Könige [Busse für] Ungehorsam gegen ihn, wenn man ihn dessen wahrheitsgemäss anschuldigt (und er sich nicht entschuldigen kann lq).
And any reeve who neglects this and will not attend to it, let him pay the king [the fine for] disobedience to him, if he is truthfully charged with it (and he cannot clear himself, lq).
